title: Imame Zamana
body:
Imam e Zamana Imam e Zamana bada dukh bhara hai hamara
fasana
Imam E Zamana Imam e Zamana
Mukhalif hua hai ya zalim zamana..
Imam E Zamana Imam e Zamana
hawas maal o zar ki na kal thi na abb hai
faqat ek nigah-e-karam ki talab hai
yahi hai jahaa'n main hamara khazana
Imam e Zamana Imam e Zamana..
Ali ke mohibbo Salamat raho
tum
jahaa'n bhi raho ba hifazat
raho tum
ataa khud karenge tumhe aab o dana
Imam e Zamana Imam e Zamana..
Luta dunga ashqo'n ke sab motio'n ko
chhupa rakha hai dil me apne ghamo'n ko
meri arzoo hai mere ghar bhi aana
Imam e Zamana Imam e Zamana...
Ziyarat ki khwahish ko dil me basa kar
mai hasrat se dhekunga nigahein uthakar
kahi'n par agar qafela ho rawana Imam e Zamana Imam e Zamana...
Mujhe to zamee'n par hi jannat mili hai
meri zindagi bandagi me dhali hai
tera astaana hai mera thikana
Imam e Zamana Imam e Zamana...
Madad kar Mohammad ke waaris hamari
mita de dil -e- zaar ki beqarari
sakhi hai zamane me tera gharana.. Imam e Zamana Imam e Zamana...
Hawao'n me roshan jo TAHIR diya hai
yahi dar haqiqat wo noor e Khuda hai
Fizao'n me gunje tera hi tarana
Imam e Zamana Imam e Zamana..
